longroom.label: 1733 · flat plaster ceiling
longroom.note: The original library had a flat plaster ceiling. Trinity gives an original height of about 15 m; the present barrel-vaulted hall is 14.2 m high.

longroom.label: 1861–today · barrel vault
longroom.note: The barrel vault was added in 1859–61. The comparison changes only the ceiling and end-wall height; furnishings and camera position stay fixed.
